text.insert: How work enters and leaves the system: the durable ProjectSession that owns the project worktree and head lineage, the operating flow from baseline sync to explicit session close, and the session timeline that defines the epoch_completed, remote_application, pr_phase, and save_point entry kinds. The session container records epoch_completed and save_point entries; the PR-campaign and sync workflow contracts own the pr_phase and remote_application writers. This section makes current head and boundary evidence answerable while keeping scheduling and shipping in their owning sections.
Session operating flow covers the target first-read flow for a ProjectSession, from baseline sync through epoch workers, PR review, remote application, and explicit close.
Project session architecture covers the durable container, the single-active-session rule, child run, PR campaign, and sync workflows, and the active workflow holding the dispatch lease.
Save points covers evidence anchors pinned to existing commits, their loud-failure blocker and staleness contract, and the transactional timeline entries that advance head.
